Rosario Central and Independiente met in a pulsating Liga Profesional encounter that kept fans on the edge of their seats until the very last whistle. The match was a story of shifting momentum, where tactical changes and individual brilliance defined the outcome in a high-intensity atmosphere. First Half Drama and an Equalizer On May 10, 2026 , the battle between these two historical sides began with high physical intensity and early bookings that set a combative tone. Independiente took the initiative in the 36th minute when Maximiliano Gutierrez found space to deliver a precise ball to Gabriel Avalos , who made no mistake in putting the visitors ahead. The goal stunned the home crowd, but Rosario Central refused to head into the break trailing. In the dying moments of the first half, Franco Ibarra set up the legendary Angel Di Maria , who found the back of the net in the 45+2 minute to level the scores and change the complexion of the game. Tactical Impact and the Decisive Finish The second half saw both managers turn to their benches to find a breakthrough, but it was the introduction of Giovanni Cantizano that proved inspired for the home side. While the game remained locked in a stalemate for much of the period, the tension peaked in the final ten minutes. In the 84th minute, Emanuel Coronel provided a crucial assist for Giovanni Cantizano , who fired Rosario Central into the lead. As Independiente pushed for a late response, the hosts exploited the gaps. Elias Veron , who had just received a yellow card, sealed the 3-1 victory in the 90+2 minute after being set up by the standout Cantizano , ensuring all three points stayed in Rosario.
